question: How does the expansion of kriyā-śakti develop into the state of māyā?
premises: As the unfolding opens gradually, the expansion of kriyā-śakti extends.
When that expansion becomes clear and distinct, it changes in character.
The clarified expansion of kriyā-śakti attains the state of māyā.
inference: The gradual clarification of kriyā-śakti's expansion culminates in its assumption of the nature of māyā.
plain_english: As it opens gradually, this expansion extends; and when the expansion of the power of action becomes clear, it will attain the state of māyā.
